injuries.detail: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
